Unsupervised and Interpretable Machine Learning for Label-Free Neonatal Phenotyping and Risk Assessment

October 2026 · License · CC BY 4.0
Abstract and figures
Neonatal intensive care units generate rich physiological data, yet most risk tools need labelled outcomes. We clustered 12,000 admissions without labels and found five interpretable phenotypes. Two phenotypes carried a threefold higher risk of sepsis and could be flagged within six hours of admission.
